request:

Count import statements anywhere in a file (top level, type-checking-only blocks, inside functions, and `__main__` demo blocks). Only imports that name the console or text module itself count, not imports of the rich package; rich/text.py qualifies if it imports rich/console.py. Give the repository-relative file paths.
